name: Amamiya Eisuke
source:
[spoiler]His real name is Aramiya Eisuke. The one protagonist meet is not the real Eisuke but the shadow that he leave before dying.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]He can change appearance. And the unknown person which have scar at his face that protagonist meet at dungeon is him which later get called as 'Scar Face'[/spoiler]
